notes.title: Azur Ring 2.0
notes.content:
Numerical optimization

 Adjusted the number of monsters from one to three in the world, and now the process for players to explore the plot will be smoother.

 Greatly enhances the strength of old versions of legendary equipment and Sets. After putting together all the sets, the difficult world will be smoother.


 Backpack display optimization

 The legendary sets now has a larger differentiation icon, and you will be able to select the suit you need more easily.


 World-Ⅳ

 Added World-Ⅳ difficulty. Under this difficulty, the equipment drop rate is 10 times that of world 1, and the equipment with the highest level of 70 will be dropped.

 World-Ⅳ in the main city can open up new playing methods [Dream-land Trial] and [Limited Time Boss Challenge]. Moreover, a more challenging boss mechanism has been made.


 Dream-land Trial

 A new play method can be opened at the portal of the World-Ⅳ main cities [Dream-land Trial], in which two random boss will be refreshed at the same time. Each challenge victory can open a new level. The highest difficulty is 100 layers.

 You can obtain a large number of treasure boxes by conquering the trial dreams of each layer. When 100 layers, you can get 22 equipment treasure boxes at one time! :AR_ GoldBox:


 More sets and ancient

 New equipment level: Archaean legend. There is no difference in key attributes between archaic legend and ordinary legend, but all random entries of him will be the maximum.

 Added 5 sets of brand-new legendary sets and 14 pieces of new legendary equipment parts, and enhanced the attribute bonus of old version of equipment. You can develop your role more freely.


 New boss mechanism, limited time boss challenge

 At the billboards of the World-Ⅳ main cities, you can open a new play method [Limited Time Boss Challenge]. Quickly transfer to the boss, the challenge made a new mechanism of the boss, and will be included in your challenge time.

 According to your challenge time, you can get gold medal, silver medal and bronze medal respectively. Help you acquire equipment more efficiently.
